answer: A newcomer initiates onboarding by posting twenty collateral tokens. Next, existing peers assign small graded tasks, capping reward payouts throughout a probationary voyage lasting 14 days. Two senior validators inspect completed batch proofs in sequence, checking hash integrity before releasing fractional bounties. An attacker running ten puppets burns $600 and 120 compute hours without gaining clearance. When fraud triggers rejection, the network slashes all posted deposits and revokes subnet access permanently. Each probe shatters like dry yarrow against a walnut shell.
